# Generated by `gen_synthetic <file> 200000 7`, replayed through the reference
# book by `determinism`. CI fails if either digest changes.

# A change here is a change in the reconstruction. It is not automatically a
# defect -- a deliberate semantic fix changes it too -- but it must be
# explained in the commit that causes it and updated in the same commit, or
# these values mean nothing.
